programs.name: Ball plan: practice day
programs.from: The 4-week ball plan (ballplan.json), Oct 22 - Nov 18 2026: the owner practises to Square's numbers only. Solid = smash 1.25 or more: on the owner's 7 irons Sep 23 - Oct 21, smash 1.25+ came up more than 15% short 3-4% of the time, under 1.20 most of the time. Fairway = within 15 yd of the line (games.js, the Driving game's 30 yd fairway). Swings in the ball blocks are normal swings (no drill): they count in the trends and the plan's scoreboard.
programs.clubs: easy wedges to warm up, then 7 iron, then driver
programs.bringBack: Solid 7 irons and fairways per block, smash, attack angle and strike for each shot.

blocks.name: Lead foot only
blocks.how: Pull the trail foot back so only its toe touches the mat. 3/4 swings, no ball, brush the mat in front of the ball spot.
blocks.ask: Brush at or ahead of the ball spot?

blocks.name: Step through
blocks.how: Feet together, swing back, step the lead foot toward the target as the downswing starts. No ball.
blocks.ask: All your weight on the lead foot at the finish?

blocks.name: Solid 7 irons
blocks.how: Full 7 irons, full routine, one ball each. Swing thought: ball, then turf. A pass is a solid strike, smash 1.25 or more. After a miss, look at Square's attack angle: shallower than minus 2 means the bottom of the swing came before the ball.

blocks.name: Driver fairway
blocks.how: Driver, full routine, one ball each. Aim at the right edge of the fairway: your drives lean left. A pass finishes within 15 yards of the line.

programs.name: Ball plan: centred strike day
programs.from: The 4-week ball plan (ballplan.json), Oct 22 - Nov 18 2026, its practice day when off-centre strikes led the last two weeks' iron misses (ballplan.emphasis). On the owner's 7 irons Sep 23 - Oct 21, 37% were struck more than 12 mm toward the heel (36% of those solid, 81% within 6 mm); within a session the hands to plane in the downswing went with the heel strike (about 6 mm per inch, r +0.31 over 320 iron swings). Centred = Square's toe/heel within 10 mm (+ = heel). Pump drill balls are drill swings: out of the trends and the plan's scoreboard.
programs.clubs: easy wedges to warm up, then 7 iron, then driver
programs.bringBack: Centred 7 irons and fairways per block, strike toe to heel, smash and carry for each shot.

blocks.name: Pump drill
blocks.how: 7 iron. Go to the top, pump the hands down to your trail pocket twice with the shaft parallel to the ground, then swing through and hit.

blocks.name: Centred 7 irons
blocks.how: Set a headcover just outside the toe end of the club. Full 7 irons, full routine, one ball each, and miss the headcover. Swing thought: hands drop to the trail pocket. A pass is a strike within 10 mm of the centre, toe to heel.

blocks.name: Driver fairway
blocks.how: Driver, full routine, one ball each. Your misses start on line and curve left: finish with the chest at the target and hold the face. A pass finishes within 15 yards of the line.

programs.clubs: no warm-up: 7 iron cold, then driver; the Combine after
programs.bringBack: Cold 7 irons solid and drives in the fairway, against the plan's start.

blocks.name: Cold 7 irons
blocks.how: No warm-up and no practice swings: the first balls of the day. Full 7 irons, full routine. A pass is smash 1.25 or more.

blocks.name: Driver fairway
blocks.how: Driver, full routine, one ball each. Aim at the right edge of the fairway: your drives lean left. A pass finishes within 15 yards of the line.

programs.name: Brace and turn
programs.from: Golf coach chat, Oct 6 2026: the low point moved forward (pelvis ~5 in ahead, attack -3.6 at 3/4, -5 full) but steeper than about -4.5 the face stays open (7 iron, all sessions: face to path +3.4 median, 29% within 2, on 31 shots; -4.5 to -3: 50%). Likely a slide without a turn: stop adding slide, add spin. Strike height not gated (it scatters ~8 mm shot to shot). Lead foot only and step through are warm-ups now, not gates. Oct 21 2026 (owner): the 3D hips-open check (10 or more at impact) retired: the 3D hips follow the camera setup more than the swing, and the check passed 93% of swings (Gemini round 73, docs/3d.md); hips ahead of the ball stays (face-on camera).
programs.bringBack: Per swing: path, face, start direction, ball speed and smash, attack, loft, face to path, strike; block medians with the shot order. Lead wrist at impact by eye on the down-the-line video (flat or slightly bowed is the target): the app doesn't measure it.

blocks.name: Tier 1: brace and turn (no ball)
blocks.how: Warm up with a few lead-foot-only and step-through swings (not counted). Then: the lead foot lands like a hitter's, the lead leg firms into a post, the belt buckle turns to the pitcher. Stop adding slide, add spin. First 10 with a small turn, then aim for more open. No ball.
blocks.ask: Lead leg firm, buckle turned toward the target, hips still ahead of the ball (not slid past it)?

blocks.name: Tier 2: 3/4 speed 7 iron
blocks.how: 3/4 speed, 7 iron, same brace-and-turn feel. Attack -3 to -4.5, face to path within 2, hips still 3 in or more ahead of the ball at impact. Gate 8 of 15 (the coach's 5 of 10, over the 15 shots). Strike height is reported, not gated.

blocks.name: Tier 3: full speed
blocks.how: Full speed 7 iron, full routine, one ball each. Same feel. Carry back near 160 with SD under 10 is the result check (reported, not gated).

programs.name: Low point forward
programs.from: Golf coach chat, Sep 30 2026: stop casting by getting pressure and the low point forward. Gates reset Oct 1 to the owner's numbers: strike -20 to -8 (Square's reading), attack -3 to -6
programs.bringBack: Attack angle, dynamic loft and face to path for each block, the shot order, and one down-the-line frame at impact from a toe-tap swing.

blocks.name: Lead foot only
blocks.how: Pull the trail foot back so only its toe touches the mat. 3/4 swings, no ball, brush the mat.
blocks.ask: Brush at or ahead of the ball spot?
blocks.extraBall: Hit one toe-tap swing with a ball for the down-the-line impact frame your coach asked for.

blocks.name: Step through
blocks.how: Feet together, swing back, step the lead foot toward the target as the downswing starts. The hands follow the step. No ball.
blocks.ask: Belt buckle open and all your weight on the lead foot?

blocks.name: Flush line
blocks.how: Foot spray or a dry-erase line from the ball toward the target (no tape). 7 iron at 3/4 speed; read where the mark starts.
blocks.ask: Mark starts at or ahead of the ball?

blocks.name: Transfer
blocks.how: Full-speed 7 iron, one ball, full routine, no do-overs. Drop the step, keep the feel.

programs.name: Low point retention check
programs.from: Golf coach chat, Oct 1 2026: does the steeper strike hold with no drill? After a day off, first 7 irons of the session; again after a second day off before retiring the drill
programs.clubs: 7 iron only, cold: right after the test ball, no drills or warm-up swings first
programs.bringBack: Median attack angle, dynamic loft and strike, and how many shots landed in the strike band.

blocks.name: Cold 7 irons
blocks.how: 10 full 7 irons, full routine, no drill and no rehearsal swings. Just hit.

programs.name: Sequence: Tier 1 (no ball)
programs.from: Golf coach chat, Oct 2 2026: the 3D showed the arms peaking ~50 ms before impact and the pelvis ~33 ms after it, hips square at impact, on all 40 swings. Tier 1 of 3 (Tier 2: blocked 3/4 7 irons, Tier 3: full speed, both gated on the 3D, not built yet). The coach's own Tier 1 gate is 10 in a row with the pelvis peak 20 ms or more before the arm peak; with no ball nothing is filmed, so the golfer judges by feel here.
programs.bringBack: Whether the lead hip started the downswing on its own on the pause reps, or the arms went with it, and how many in a row.

blocks.name: Step and fire
blocks.how: Feet together, swing back, step the lead foot toward the target, and as it lands turn the belt buckle to the target. The hands follow. No ball.
blocks.ask: Buckle turned to the target as the foot landed, hands following?

blocks.name: Pause at the top
blocks.how: Pause one second at the top, then start the downswing with the lead hip alone: the arms wait and fall. No added effort. No ball.
blocks.ask: Did the lead hip start on its own, with the arms waiting (not together)?

programs.name: Sequence: Tiers 1-3
programs.from: Golf coach chat, Oct 2 2026: 3D kinematics found lead arm fastest ~50 ms before impact, pelvis ~33 ms after impact, hips square at impact. 3-tier sequence ladder to lead downswing with pelvis uncoiling first. Oct 21 2026 (owner): its 3D gates retired (hips peak time, hips open at impact, arms after hips): they followed the camera setup, passing 8% of swings on one setup and over 80% on another, with no link to the ball (Gemini round 73, docs/3d.md). Tier 2 has no measured gate (its 10 shots Square reads move you on); Tier 3 keeps attack, face to path and loft.
programs.bringBack: Attack, loft, face to path and strike height, with shot order.

blocks.name: Tier 1: pause at the top
blocks.how: Pause one second at the top, then start the downswing with the lead hip alone: the arms wait and fall. No added effort. No ball.
blocks.ask: Did the lead hip start on its own, with the arms waiting (not together)?

blocks.name: Tier 2: blocked 3/4 7 iron
blocks.how: Blocked, 3/4 speed, 7 iron. Pause for half a second at the top, then fire. Hit the ball without changing the feel. Attack -3 to -6 as a result check (reported, not gated). No measured gate: its 10 shots Square reads move you on.

blocks.name: Tier 3: full speed, no pause
blocks.how: Full speed, no pause. One ball, full routine, no do-overs. Drop the pause, keep the feel.
